translationRepairs: Of Liu Yan's four sons, Fan served as a general of the household left, Dan as document censor, and Zhang as commandant of the imperial equipage—all at Emperor Xian's court in Chang'an—while only Separate Division Marshal Mao stayed with his father in Yi.

Of Liu Yan's four sons, Fan served as general of the gentlemen of the household for the left, Dan as attendant censor for documents, and Zhang as commandant of the imperial carriages—all at Emperor Xian's court in Chang'an—while only Separate Division Marshal Mao stayed with his father in Yi.

左中郎將 is 'general of the gentlemen of the household for the left', garbled as 'general of the household left'; 治書御史 is attendant censor for documents; 奉車都尉 is commandant of the imperial carriages, not 'equipage'.
Cao Cao named Liu Zhang general who inspires awe and his brother Liu Mao general who pacifies bandits.
Cao Cao named Liu Zhang general who inspires awe and his elder brother Liu Mao general who pacifies bandits.
兄 specifies that Liu Mao was Liu Zhang's elder brother.

Zhang's registrar, Huang Quan of Ba, remonstrated: "Liu Bei has the reputation of an owl. If you treat him as a subordinate leader, you will not satisfy his heart; if you treat him as a guest, one state cannot hold two lords. This is not a way to secure yourself."

Zhang's registrar, Huang Quan of Baxi, remonstrated: "Liu Bei has a name for ferocity. If you treat him as a subordinate leader, you will not satisfy his heart; if you treat him as a guest, one state cannot hold two lords. This is not a way to secure yourself."
巴西 is Baxi commandery, not Ba; 梟名 means a reputation for fierce valor, not 'the reputation of an owl'.
Entering Nan Zheng, Cao Cao applauded the gesture.
Entering Nanzheng, Cao Cao applauded the gesture.
南鄭 is the city of Nanzheng, not a two-word 'Nan Zheng'.
He latched onto the prophecy that "the successor to Han is at Dangtu Gao" and insisted his own name matched it.
He had also read in prophetic texts that "the one who replaces Han will be the tall one on the road (dangtu gao)," and claimed that his own name and courtesy name fulfilled it.
當塗高 is the wording of the prophecy ('tall one on the road'), not a person or place named Dangtu Gao; 名字 refers to both his name 術 and courtesy name 公路.
Han may be declining, but it is no ruined Shang under Zhou Xin."
Han may be declining, but it has not reached the ruin of Yin under King Zhou."
殷紂 is King Zhou of Yin (Shang), not 'Zhou Xin', which collides with Yuan Shao's general Zhou Xin in this chapter.
Aid him as the Duke of Zhou aided King Cheng and the realm will praise you.
Aid him to prosper and you will earn the glory of Dan and Shi, the Dukes of Zhou and Shao—what the whole realm hopes for.
旦、奭 are the Duke of Zhou (Dan) and the Duke of Shao (Shi); King Cheng is not mentioned.
With Sun Jian still far away fighting Dong Zhuo, Yuan Shao sent Zhou Xin of Kuaiji to wrest Yu Province from him.
With Sun Jian still far away fighting Dong Zhuo, Yuan Shu's elder cousin Yuan Shao sent his general Zhou Xin of Kuaiji to wrest Yu Province from him.
從兄紹 identifies Yuan Shao as Yuan Shu's elder cousin, omitted in the translation; 遣其將 makes Zhou Xin his general.
Wang Yun was already plotting Dong Zhuo's death with Sun Rui; he enlisted Lü Bu as insider.
Wang Yun was already plotting Dong Zhuo's death with Shisun Rui, vice director of the Imperial Secretariat; he enlisted Lü Bu as insider.
士孫瑞 has the compound surname Shisun; 'Sun Rui' drops part of the surname, and his office 尚書僕射 is omitted.
Lü Bu agreed and stabbed Dong Zhuo at the gate, as told in Dong Zhuo's memoir.
Lü Bu agreed and stabbed Dong Zhuo at the gate, as told in the Biography of Dong Zhuo.
《卓傳》 is a cross-reference to the Biography of Dong Zhuo in this history, not a 'memoir'.
Chen Gui feared a Xu–Yang alliance if the wedding closed.
Chen Gui, chancellor of Pei, feared that if Yuan Shu and Lü Bu completed the marriage alliance, Xu and Yang would join forces and the trouble would never end.
The translation omits 沛相 (chancellor of Pei), who would marry (術報布成姻), and the consequence 為難未已.
Lü Bu fled to White Gate Tower with his family.
Lü Bu climbed White Gate Tower with his followers.
麾下 means the troops under his banner, not his family; 登 is 'climbed', not 'fled to'.
Remember Ding Yuan and Dong Zhuo?"
My lord, have you not seen how Lü Bu served Ding Jianyang and Grand Preceptor Dong?"
The translation drops 明公 and the point of the question, Lü Bu's service to (and betrayal of) Ding Yuan, styled Jianyang, and Grand Preceptor Dong Zhuo.
